newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Prairies see snow in Alberta's Peace River.
newsitem.headline: Canada Prairies see snow in Alberta's Peace River.

text.p: Canada's Prairie grain belt Thursday saw snow in Alberta's Peace River Valley with snow forecast for southeastern Manitoba later in the day, Environment Canada said.
Eight to 10 mm of precipitation fell between Peace River and Fort McMurray, Alberta, in the last 24 hours, meteorologist Clarence Spelchak said.
Five to 10 mm of precipitation was expected to fall in the form of snow east of Winnipeg later Thursday, he added.
There was no precipitation reported elsewhere on the Prairies. Rain and snow have delayed harvest progress.
Manitoba harvested 85 percent of crops by Tuesday, Saskatchewan combined 78 percent, Alberta had 75 of crops in the bin by Tuesday.
Alberta should see highs of 0 to 9.0 Celsius.
Saskatchewan should see highs of 2.0 to 9.0 Celsius with a chance of flurries.
Manitoba should see highs of 0 to 8.0 Celsius with snow in the southeast.
